Riftlet 1.0.5 (31)
截图资料现在可以按留存期整理，也可以手动移入系统废纸篓，再从 Riftlet 找回。旧用户沿用原有留存策略，系统截图原件保留。内置截图在收录中断后可从菜单进入「管理」找回。设置与截图仓库增加了对应的恢复入口，大图库会优先载入可见图片。
如果原附件在原草稿中明确报错，截图可在「需要处理」中找到，并可在有原对话记录时返回核对。Riftlet 不会自动发送消息或重新上传状态不明的截图。真实 ChatGPT 首次、连续双图及服务端终止后的恢复，在本版隔离验收中因未能连接到可用草稿而未验证。
下载 Riftlet-1.0.5.dmg，打开后将 Riftlet 拖入「应用程序」。手动升级时先退出旧版，再替换原安装位置的 App。支持 Apple Silicon 与 Intel；最低系统要求为 macOS 13。应用与磁盘映像均已通过 Apple 公证。
Riftlet can now move eligible private screenshot copies to the system Trash and restore them. Existing libraries keep their retention settings. Interrupted captures can be recovered from Manage, and large libraries load visible screenshots first.
When the original attachment reports an error, Needs Attention helps you find the screenshot and check its saved conversation. Riftlet never sends messages or automatically uploads an uncertain attachment again. The isolated release test could not reach a live ChatGPT draft, so first-click, rapid two-image attachment and recovery from a server-side terminal failure remain unverified on the live service.
Open Riftlet-1.0.5.dmg and drag Riftlet to Applications. For a manual update, quit the old app and replace it in the same location. The app and disk image are notarized by Apple. The universal app supports Apple Silicon and Intel and requires macOS 13 or later.
